summary: ParaZero Technologies Ltd. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing a live U.S. demonstration of its DefendAir net launcher system after SOF Week 2026. The demonstration for defense stakeholders showed 100% success intercepting FPV drones. No financial terms, mergers, acquisitions, or corporate structural changes were disclosed. The filing is a routine current report of a foreign private issuer on a non-material operational milestone. This is a standard press release update, not a special-situation event.
